column2: Residents piled sandbags along the levee as the river rose past midnight.
column3: 河水在午夜後持續上漲，居民沿著堤防堆起沙包。
column4: build a levee (築起堤防)
column5: levee 和 level 長得像：水位 level 升高，就靠 levee 擋住

column2: His joke about the budget added a moment of levity to the tense meeting.
column3: 他拿預算開的玩笑，為緊繃的會議增添了片刻輕鬆。
column4: a moment of levity (一刻的輕鬆戲謔)
column5: lev 是輕（像 elevate 抬起）：心情輕飄飄，開玩笑不夠莊重

column2: She showed great magnanimity by forgiving the rival who had spread rumors about her.
column3: 她寬恕了散播自己謠言的對手，展現了極大的氣度。
column4: show magnanimity in victory (勝利時展現雅量)
column5: magn 大 + anim 心：心胸大，才能原諒別人

column2: The foreman suspected the new worker was a malingerer who faked a sore back to avoid lifting.
column3: 領班懷疑那位新工人是裝病逃避工作的人，假裝背痛以免搬重物。
column4: labeled a malingerer (被貼上裝病者的標籤)
column5: mal 壞 + linger 賴著不走：賴在原地假裝生病不做事

column2: After losing the final, he sat morose and silent in the locker room.
column3: 輸掉決賽後，他悶悶不樂、沉默地坐在更衣室裡。
column4: morose and silent (陰鬱沉默的)
column5: 諧音「魔肉絲」：魔肉絲被搶走了，整天愁眉苦臉不說話

column2: As a neophyte in the chess club, she lost her first ten games.
column3: 身為西洋棋社的新手，她輸掉了前十盤棋。
column4: a political neophyte (政治新手)
column5: neo 新 + phyte 植物：剛種下的小苗，就是新手

column2: Thick smoke occluded the sun, and the valley fell into early dusk.
column3: 濃煙遮住了太陽，山谷提早陷入黃昏般的昏暗。
column4: occlude the sun (遮蔽太陽)
column5: oc 擋在前面 + clude 關閉（像 close）：把光擋住關起來

column2: An officious clerk kept correcting how visitors filled out forms nobody had asked him to check.
column3: 一位多管閒事的職員不斷糾正訪客填表的方式，而沒人要他檢查。
column4: an officious bureaucrat (愛管閒事的官僚)
column5: office 辦公室裡總有人什麼都要插手、指揮別人

column2: The mayor faced public opprobrium after the secret deal came to light.
column3: 秘密交易曝光後，市長遭到公開的譴責。
column4: public opprobrium (公開的譴責)
column5: 諧音「噢！破布」：被大家指指點點，丟臉丟到像破布

column2: Her ostentatious diamond necklace drew stares at the quiet village wedding.
column3: 她那條炫耀的鑽石項鍊在安靜的村莊婚禮上引來側目。
column4: an ostentatious display of wealth (炫富的展示)
column5: 字根 ostend 是展示：愛把財富擺出來給大家看

column2: Teachers held her up as a paragon of patience and fairness.
column3: 老師們把她視為耐心與公平的典範。
column4: a paragon of virtue (美德的典範)
column5: 諧音「趴啦棍」：大家趴下來膜拜的完美模範

column2: His pathological fear of failure kept him from submitting any work at all.
column3: 他對失敗有病態的恐懼，以致一件作品都交不出去。
column4: pathological liar (病態說謊者)
column5: path 是病痛或感受（像 sympathy）+ log 學：病理學上的異常

column2: After the factory closed, the family lived in penury for years.
column3: 工廠關閉後，這家人過了好幾年赤貧的生活。
column4: live in penury (過著赤貧生活)
column5: pen 是筆：窮到只剩一支筆（pen），什麼都買不起

column2: The perfidious ally secretly sold the king's battle plans to the enemy.
column3: 那個背信棄義的盟友暗中把國王的作戰計畫賣給敵人。
column4: a perfidious friend (背信的朋友)
column5: per 違背 + fid 信任（像 fidelity 忠誠）：違背信任

column2: While everyone else panicked, the phlegmatic captain calmly checked the map again.
column3: 其他人都慌了，沉著冷靜的船長卻平靜地再看一次地圖。
column4: phlegmatic temperament (冷靜沉著的性情)
column5: 古人以為痰（phlegm）多的人個性冷靜、慢條斯理

column2: The plasticity of a child's brain lets it rewire quickly after injury.
column3: 孩子大腦的可塑性使它在受傷後能迅速重新連結。
column4: brain plasticity (大腦可塑性)
column5: plastic 塑膠能捏成各種形狀，加 ity 就是可塑性

column2: Share prices plummeted by half within an hour of the announcement.
column3: 消息公布後一小時內，股價暴跌了一半。
column4: prices plummet (價格暴跌)
column5: plum 李子 met 地面：李子從樹上直直掉到地上

column2: The hiker rested on a precarious ledge barely wide enough for two boots.
column3: 登山客在一塊窄得只容兩隻靴子的危險岩架上休息。
column4: a precarious position (岌岌可危的處境)
column5: 把 car 停在懸崖邊，隨時會掉下去，真危險

column2: The sudden ban precipitated a crisis among small farmers.
column3: 突然的禁令引發了小農之間的危機。
column4: precipitate a crisis (引發危機)
column5: 字根 cap 是頭：頭朝下往前栽，一下子加速又倉促

column2: It was presumptuous of the intern to rewrite the director's speech without asking.
column3: 實習生沒問過就改寫主任的演講稿，實在太自以為是。
column4: a presumptuous question (冒昧的問題)
column5: pre 先 + sume 拿：沒被允許就先拿，太放肆

column2: Hikers were amazed by the pristine lake, untouched by roads or litter.
column3: 健行者對那座沒有道路或垃圾打擾的原始純淨湖泊驚嘆不已。
column4: in pristine condition (處於嶄新無瑕的狀態)
column5: prist 與 prime 同源，是最初的樣子：像剛下的第一場雪

column2: Critics found the study's sample size problematic, since only twelve people took part.
column3: 評論者認為這項研究的樣本數有問題，因為只有十二人參加。
column4: a problematic assumption (有疑問的假設)
column5: problem 問題加上 atic：變成形容詞，就是有問題的

column2: She dressed with careful propriety for the formal court ceremony.
column3: 她為了正式的宮廷典禮，穿著得體、謹守禮數。
column4: a breach of propriety (違反禮節)
column5: proper 是合宜的，ety 變名詞：行為合宜的規矩

column2: The new law proscribes the sale of fireworks near schools.
column3: 新法律禁止在學校附近販售煙火。
column4: proscribe the practice (明令禁止這種做法)
column5: pro 在前 + scribe 寫：公告上寫明禁止；和 prescribe 開處方別搞混

column2: The pungent smell of garlic filled the whole kitchen.
column3: 大蒜刺鼻的氣味充滿了整間廚房。
column4: pungent smell (刺鼻的氣味)
column5: 字根 pung 是刺（像 puncture 刺破）：辛辣得像被針戳到鼻子

column2: The board gave only qualified support to the plan, demanding several changes first.
column3: 董事會只對這項計畫給予有保留的支持，要求先做幾項修改。
column4: qualified approval (有保留的同意)
column5: qualified 除了有資格，也像附但書的通行證：有條件才算數

column2: Let's not quibble over a few cents when the whole project is at stake.
column3: 整個專案都在危急關頭，我們別再為幾分錢斤斤計較了。
column4: quibble over details (為細節爭辯)
column5: 諧音「虧波」：為了小細節虧來虧去，吹毛求疵

column2: He spent his career in the rarefied air of theoretical physics, far from everyday concerns.
column3: 他整個職涯都待在遠離日常煩惱、曲高和寡的理論物理圈裡。
column4: rarefied air (稀薄的空氣)
column5: rare 稀少 + fy 使變成：高山空氣稀薄，高深圈子也少人能到

column2: Under pressure, the scientist refused to recant his findings.
column3: 在壓力之下，這位科學家拒絕撤回他的研究發現。
column4: recant his testimony (撤回他的證詞)
column5: re 回 + cant 唱（像 chant）：把唱過的歌收回來

column2: After the scandal, the manager was relegated to a small office in the basement.
column3: 醜聞過後，經理被貶到地下室的一間小辦公室。
column4: relegated to the sidelines (被降到邊緣位置)
column5: re 退回 + leg 派遣：被派到後面去，位置降級

column2: The villagers shunned the old reprobate who gambled away his family's farm.
column3: 村民們迴避那個把全家農場賭光的老無賴。
column4: an incorrigible reprobate (無可救藥的惡棍)
column5: re 反 + prove 證明：被證明不及格、被眾人唾棄的壞蛋

column2: She resolved to practice every morning until she could play the piece perfectly.
column3: 她下定決心每天早上練習，直到能完美演奏這首曲子。
column4: resolve to improve (下定決心改進)
column5: re 再三 + solve 解：再三想清楚，決心解決問題

column2: The village sage was consulted whenever a dispute seemed impossible to settle.
column3: 每當紛爭似乎無法解決，村民就會請教村裡的智者。
column4: sage advice (睿智的建議)
column5: sage 也是鼠尾草：白鬍子智者在花園裡給你好建議

column2: Children satiated with sweets turned away from the cake they had begged for.
column3: 吃糖吃到膩的孩子，不再理會剛才吵著要吃的蛋糕。
column4: satiate his hunger (滿足他的飢餓)
column5: sat 同 satisfy 的 sat（足夠）：吃到飽，甚至吃膩了

column2: She savored every bite of the warm bread on the cold morning.
column3: 在寒冷的早晨，她細細品味每一口溫熱的麵包。
column4: savor the moment (細細品味當下)
column5: 諧音「沙發」：窩在沙發上慢慢品嚐美食
